rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies a very poor-quality, minimally cavitating early blast/cavitating morula with absent distinct ICM and poorly defined TE, consistent with 0DD. Minor limitation is some speculative wording about degeneration/fragments and no comment on zona features.

Strongly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, endometrium, unexplained infertility, semen parameters, and first-cycle status with the embryo-level prognosis, clearly distinguishing favorable patient factors from poor embryo quality.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent: poor morphology drives prognosis despite favorable maternal/uterine factors, and the low implantation estimate is well supported by the described findings and clinical context.

Generally well aligned with IVF practice and Gardner grading caveats on day-4 assessment, and recommendations are evidence-based. Slight deduction because the specific implantation estimate is somewhat subjective and some suggestions (e.g., sperm DNA fragmentation) are more conditional than guideline-standard after one cycle.

Provides clear practical guidance for current transfer management and sensible future-cycle planning, including review of embryology course, stimulation optimization, conditional male-factor workup, and transfer strategy nuances.
